feedback: Accepted. The progression chain u0->u1->u2->u3->u4 via blocker_moved, has_door_key, door_open, target_picked_up matches every environment ordering constraint, and target_picked_up is reachable only from u3, honoring the box-after-door requirement. The key_lost penalty is correctly scoped: it can physically fire only in u0 (ball never moved, so the door is provably closed) and u2 (blocker moved, door not yet open), and it is penalized -0.2 in exactly those states. It is provably impossible in u1 (entering u1 requires picking up the ball with empty hands, and any key pickup while in u1 moves the RM to u2 first, so has_door_key was false the prior step whenever the RM sits in u1) and in u3 (the door cannot be relocked, so key_lost's not-door_open condition fails); hence no penalty is missed and none is misapplied to the legal end-game key drop after opening the door, matching the seed-0 trace where the step-19 drop fires nothing. The key-first strategy, which necessarily drops the key while the door is closed, is penalized, implementing the task clause 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' without ever penalizing the required post-opening drop. Every state has an else self-loop covering irrelevant or impossible labels; only the five given propositions plus else are used; event vs. persistent distinctions are respected (key_lost penalized per firing with no latching; conditions latch, which is safe because blocker_moved regression cannot produce spurious rewards and door_open cannot regress since relocking is impossible). Rewards are dense, strictly increasing (0.1/0.2/0.3/1.0), bounded, and unfarmable since every positive transition advances the state; the -0.2 penalty is per-event and per-step bounded, so repeated key drops accumulate only negative value. FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty, u4 is declared and accepting (the episode terminates on target_picked_up), INITIAL_STATE and the transition/reward tables follow the paper's RM schema, with unspecified else self-loop rewards defaulting to 0 per convention. Minor harmless note: when has_door_key and door_open coincide at the toggle step, u1 takes the has_door_key transition and door_open is credited one step later; since door_open persists, no reward is lost.

feedback: All five environment-declared propositions are implemented as functions with exactly matching names, and there are no undeclared extra functions. blocker_moved is faithful: it scans the grid for the unique door (the documented way to find it), guards the door and ball cells against None, and tests the single ball cell (dx-1, dy) directly in front of the door on the start side, which is equivalent to the reference single-cell expression; since a carried ball is absent from the grid it correctly counts as moved, the door object remains in the grid when open so a later drop-back re-falsifies it, and it is a correct non-latch condition rather than a latch. has_door_key, door_open, and target_picked_up match the reference expressions exactly, including the mission-matched box color via the f-string and the None-guarded carrying checks. key_lost has correct event semantics: it reads env.episode_memory["previous_valuation"] read-only, requires has_door_key true at the previous step, the key-carrying expression false now, and door_open false now, so it fires for exactly the one step after the key is dropped while the door is closed and never co-occurs with has_door_key, door_open, or target_picked_up, consistent with the stated constraints; re-evaluating K and D inline is pure and side-effect free. Persistent propositions read only current state; only the event touches the previous snapshot, and nothing mutates the environment or episode memory. Only documented API attributes are used (env.grid.get, env.width, env.height, env.carrying, env.mission, the previous valuation) with empty-cell guards before attribute reads; there are no imports, no actions, no out-of-bounds coordinate access (the x-scan starts at 1 so x-1 stays in bounds), and the syntax is valid executable Python. The leading truthiness guard on the previous valuation is benign since the snapshot is guaranteed to be a present, complete, non-empty valuation, so every function returns a strict boolean at runtime.
